item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena notices that her mother leaves the tap running while washing vegetables at their home in Jaipur.

Which natural resource is being wasted in this activity, and what is the best way for Meena's family to reduce this waste?

options.A: Soil is being wasted; they should grow vegetables at home instead of buying them.
options.B: Water is being wasted; they should wash vegetables in a bowl of water instead of under a running tap.
options.C: Air is being polluted; they should wash vegetables outdoors.
options.D: Food is being wasted; they should stop washing vegetables before cooking.
